notes.web.url: launch may be a URL (https://...) or a local .html/.js file path; web.url overrides it
notes.profile: the backend starts a throwaway browser profile: isolated from the user's own profile, no sign-in, no sync, deleted by close
notes.click: VALUE=css=<selector> | text=<visible text> | X,Y[,left|right|double]; hidden/disabled/covered elements are refused
notes.headless: headless=true runs without a window (CI); screenshots still work
